outputs.explanation: Panel A is a representative western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel B consists of phase-contrast micrographs, not a plot.

The top of panel C is a representative flow-cytometry density plot (single run, not an average, so no points needed). The bottom bar chart (mean ± SEM, n=3) displays individual replicate data points as overlaid markers (circles, squares, triangles) on each bar.
Similar to panel C, the top is a representative flow-cytometry plot (no averaging, points not needed) and the bottom bar chart (mean ± SD, n=3) shows individual data points overlaid on the bars.
Panel E is a heatmap of RNA-seq Z-scores; heatmaps are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.
Panel F is a representative western blot image, not a plot of averaged data.
Both bar charts in panel G (mean ± SEM, n=3) display individual data points as overlaid markers for each replicate.
Panel H shows representative immunofluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
